added_step_names: Cold-build typed native dropout and independently qualify history ownership
Validate released Storage metadata and strict 640-byte observer refusals
Compare typed dropout owner with unchanged live oracle (32 cases)
Regress typed-dropout owner against all unchanged 35 Tensor cases with exact 640-byte accounting
Check original copied-snapshot refusals against the typed-dropout full35 journals
Export complete typed-dropout native execution evidence
Index original typed-dropout 640-byte journals and oracle reports
Export original typed-dropout 640-byte journals and wire traces

Makefile_insertions.text:
NATIVE_DROPOUT_INPUTS := $(wildcard tools/native_dropout/* tests/native_dropout_review/* tests/native_dropout_review/*/* tests/native_dropout_identity9/* tests/dtype_resource_review/* tests/dtype_owner_accounting/* validation/native-dropout/reference/*) tests/qualify_native_dropout.py Makefile

.PHONY: native-dropout test-native-dropout
native-dropout: build/native-dropout/build.json

build/native-dropout/build.json: build/retained-gradients/build.json $(NATIVE_DROPOUT_INPUTS) | build
	@set -eu; tmp=$$(mktemp -d "$(CURDIR)/build/.native-dropout.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM; \
	python3 -I -S -B tools/native_dropout/build.py --parent "$(CURDIR)/build/retained-gradients" \
	  --repository "$(CURDIR)" --upstream "$(HEPTA_SOURCE_ROOT)" \
	  --compiler "$(HEPTA_STACK_BUILD)/native/stack-module-compiler" --linker "$(HEPTA_STACK_BUILD)/native/stack-linker-session" \
	  --output "$$tmp/native"; \
	mkdir -p build/native-dropout; cp -a --remove-destination "$$tmp/native/." build/native-dropout/

test-native-dropout: retained-gradients
	@set -eu; review=$$(mktemp -d "$(CURDIR)/build/.native-dropout-review.XXXXXX"); status=0; \
	python3 -I -S -B tests/qualify_native_dropout.py --repo "$(CURDIR)" \
	  --parent-build "$(CURDIR)/build/retained-gradients" --upstream "$(HEPTA_SOURCE_ROOT)" \
	  --compiler "$(HEPTA_STACK_BUILD)/native/stack-module-compiler" --linker "$(HEPTA_STACK_BUILD)/native/stack-linker-session" \
	  --flat-compiler "$$(command -v "$(HEPTA_COMPILER)")" --stack-build "$(HEPTA_STACK_BUILD)" \
	  --output "$$review/observed" || status=$$?; \
	if [ -f "$$review/observed/report.json" ]; then cp "$$review/observed/report.json" build/hosted-native-dropout-native.json; fi; \
	if [ -f "$$review/observed/evidence-manifest.json" ]; then cp "$$review/observed/evidence-manifest.json" build/native-dropout-ci-raw-manifest.json; fi; \
	if [ -f "$$review/observed/raw-evidence.tar.xz" ]; then cp "$$review/observed/raw-evidence.tar.xz" build/native-dropout-ci-raw.tar.xz; fi; \
	test "$$status" -eq 0 || exit "$$status"; \
	test -f build/hosted-native-dropout-native.json; \
	test -f build/native-dropout-ci-raw-manifest.json; test -f build/native-dropout-ci-raw.tar.xz; \
	mkdir -p build/native-dropout; cp -a --remove-destination "$$review/observed/producer/native/." build/native-dropout/

workflow_insertions.text:
- name: Cold-build typed native dropout and independently qualify history ownership
        run: |
          status=0
          make test-native-dropout \
            HEPTA_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.toolchain/hepta" \
            HEPTA_STACK_BUILD="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-stack-budget" \
            HEPTA_COMPILER="$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-expanded/hia-native-compiler" || status=$?
          if [ -f build/hosted-native-dropout-native.json ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/hosted-native-dropout-native.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Validate released Storage metadata and strict 640-byte observer refusals
        run: |
          status=0
          python3 -I -S -B tests/dtype_frozen35_accounting/test_storage_tombstone.py \
            --binary build/native-dropout/tensor-dtype-dropout-session \
            --source build/native-dropout/runtime.hepta \
            --protocol tests/retained_nonleaf_review/protocol.py \
            --output build/frozen35-dtype-node/storage-tombstone || status=$?
          if [ -f build/frozen35-dtype-node/storage-tombstone/report.json ]; then
            cp build/frozen35-dtype-node/storage-tombstone/report.json build/native-dropout-storage-tombstone.json
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/native-dropout-storage-tombstone.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

- name: Compare typed dropout owner with unchanged live oracle (32 cases)
        run: |
          echo '554671168c7a4a408dc1e1df89a19db15c3efcefcf4ae1a300af1b6dcae40160  tests/pytorch_tensor_rng_backward_oracle.py' | sha256sum -c -
          status=0
          python3 tests/pytorch_tensor_rng_backward_oracle.py \
            --native build/native-dropout/tensor-dtype-dropout-session \
            --source build/native-dropout/runtime.hepta \
            --expected-native-sha256 830f0b4ef8d6ad8c6a105be56d383628b45c84e3e43905fee6812c7c52d35a51 \
            --expected-source-sha256 6ffe509afce28ff15705b4c7b269eaef8f8f89f9d8b2486d4d9fa45b6be66ef3 \
            --repo . --output build/pytorch-native-dropout-backward.json > build/pytorch-native-dropout-backward.stdout || status=$?
          python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-native-dropout-backward.json
          exit "$status"

      - name: Regress typed-dropout owner against all unchanged 35 Tensor cases with exact 640-byte accounting
        run: |
          echo '149b41c455444edeb8d25d0ad98045e29683e780f37f7e210e7985242d359597  tests/tensor_object_oracle/pytorch_tensor_objects_oracle.py' | sha256sum -c -
          status=0
          python3 tests/dtype_frozen35_accounting/run_frozen35_accounted.py \
            --legacy-directory tests/tensor_object_oracle \
            --native-source build/native-dropout/runtime.hepta \
            --observer-output build/frozen35-dtype-node/523 \
            --observer-report build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35.json \
            -- build/native-dropout/tensor-dtype-dropout-session build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-original.json \
            --owned-reference tests/owned_tensor_oracle/pytorch_owned_tensor_oracle.py \
            --session-reference tests/pytorch_session_oracle.py --reference tests/pytorch_oracle.py \
            --lock compatibility/pytorch-oracle-lock.json --repo . \
            --trace-directory build/frozen35-dtype-node-wire/523 \
            --expected-native-sha256 830f0b4ef8d6ad8c6a105be56d383628b45c84e3e43905fee6812c7c52d35a51 || status=$?
          if [ -f build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35.json ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35.json
          fi
          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
            python3 -I -S -B tests/dtype_frozen35_accounting/check_frozen35_accounted.py \
              --observer-report build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35.json \
              --original-report build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-original.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

      - name: Check original copied-snapshot refusals against the typed-dropout full35 journals
        run: |
          status=0
          python3 -I -S -B tests/dtype_frozen35_accounting/check_owner_snapshots.py \
            --observer tests/dtype_frozen35_accounting/owner_accounting523.py \
            --expected-profile dtype-native-dropout-523 \
            --journals build/frozen35-dtype-node/523/owners \
            --output build/frozen35-dtype-node/523/copied-controls || status=$?
          if [ -f build/frozen35-dtype-node/523/copied-controls/report.json ]; then
            cp build/frozen35-dtype-node/523/copied-controls/report.json build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-observer-controls.json
            python3 -I -S -B tools/emit_ci_report.py build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-observer-controls.json
          fi
          exit "$status"

- name: Export complete typed-dropout native execution evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: native-dropout-native-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: |
            build/native-dropout-ci-raw.tar.xz
            build/native-dropout-ci-raw-manifest.json
            build/hosted-native-dropout-native.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Index original typed-dropout 640-byte journals and oracle reports
        if: always()
        env:
          HEPTATORCH_SOURCE_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          HEPTATORCH_OBSERVER_ARTIFACT: dtype-node-journals-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
        run: |
          python3 -I -S -B tests/private_node_accounting/collect_private_node_journals.py \
            --build build --journal-root build/frozen35-dtype-node --wire-root build/frozen35-dtype-node-wire \
            --reports build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35.json build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-original.json \
              build/pytorch-native-dropout-frozen35-observer-controls.json build/native-dropout-storage-tombstone.json \
              build/pytorch-native-dropout-backward.json build/pytorch-install.json \
            --job-status '${{ job.status }}'

      - name: Export original typed-dropout 640-byte journals and wire traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: dtype-node-journals-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: |
            build/frozen35-dtype-node/
            build/frozen35-dtype-node-wire/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          compression-level: 9
          retention-days: 30
